notes.title: V1.4 Full full screen mode.
notes.notes:
V1.4 Clicking maximize on the initial small window now goes to a total full screen mode, without the title banner or borders, to maximize the game screen.

NOTE: press the Esc key to exit full screen mode.

(This modification will not effect players who operate in "big picture mode" AKA "ten foot screen mode")

notes.title: V1.3 Customizable colours.
notes.notes:
Release of V1.3.
With this update you can choose your own paper and ink colours.
Access the colour settings by pressing F1 or 'H'.   When you move the adjuster colour sliders, which are at the bottom of the Help/Settings window, the colour in the picture frame will change as desired.

notes.title: Help update. V1.2
notes.notes:
TraptionBakery has been updated to  V1.2

This update improves help and instructions.

It now displays a prompt (at the bottom of the screen) to say how to pan the view.
   (Pan the view by pressing and holding left mouse button and moving the mouse.)
Many apologies that this information was missing before.

It now also prompts that you can press F1 for help, and the instructions you get by pressing F1 have been improved too.

(You can see the version number by pressing F1 to display the help window.  The version number is in small text at the bottom of the help window)

notes.title: Traption Bakery is a nonsensical bread-making puzzle box
notes.notes:
As I understand, every single person over the age of 25 took up baking the second lockdown went into effect. Granted, I did not, and that’s probably because the process of baking seems about as complicated as its representation in upcycling puzzler Traption Bakery. Released this week, Jon Prestidge’s lovingly-drawn construct ’em up asks you to turn piles of garbage into a self-sufficient baking monstrosity.
